features.description: Use Amp at ampcode.com with no install; threads run in cloud orbs.
Native apps for macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone, iPad, and Android, adding notifications, dictation, and sharing from other apps.
Interactive terminal Amp (`amp`) with piped-input mode, shell completions, and multi-account login; macOS, Linux, Windows via WSL.
Connects Amp to VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, or Neovim: it sees your open file/selection and edits through the IDE with full undo.
Cloud sandboxes created per thread with your code, plugins, and dev tools; agents keep working with your laptop closed, and idle orbs pause and cost nothing.
`--executor local|orb|runner:ID` chooses where each thread runs: your machine, an Amp-hosted cloud orb, or a connected self-hosted runner.
`amp --no-tui` turns any machine into a runner serving remote threads; self-hosted orbs and runners are free on every tier.
Frontier models including GPT-6/6.1 (Luna, Sol, Terra), Claude Fable 5/5.1, Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 4 (Argon/Carbon/Hydrogen), Grok 4.3, and GLM-5.
Bring your own keys or link your ChatGPT/Claude subscriptions; no Amp token fees or limits on Hobby, Individual, or Teams tiers.
Saved conversations with a searchable Activity feed (time/status/author/project filters, shareable URLs), a Changes diff view, and Amp-Thread-ID trailers on commits and PRs.
Share dialog grants access to specific people, the workspace, or anyone via unguessable 'Unlisted' links; public discoverable sharing was removed.
Built-in personal assistant for starting, monitoring, and messaging agents and projects (Ctrl+/ on web, palette command in the TUI, share-sheet on mobile).
Authenticated URLs that expose web servers running inside orbs, so you can preview apps and annotate pages with comments sent to the agent.
AGENTS.md files read automatically from the cwd, parents, and subtrees, plus personal, system-wide, and workspace 'Global AGENTS.md' instruction files.
Plugins and skills that extend Amp agents, shared across workspace members (full docs pages sit behind sign-in).
Paste images into the CLI prompt with Ctrl+V or drag-and-drop from the file manager.
Hobby free (pay-as-you-go orbs), Individual Megawatt/Gigawatt $20/mo with 45,000 hosted-orb minutes (Megawatt 50 at $50/mo), Teams no extra charge, Enterprise custom, education discount $10/mo.
Orb minutes billed by size plus Amp credits charged at providers' API prices with no markup; check with `amp usage` or ask Amp to explain your spend.
SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM directory sync, audit logs, spend limits, MCP registry allowlists, IP allowlisting, zero/minimum data retention, and SOC 2 Type 2 certification.
